note: Real Simulink R2025a periodic algebraic loop: r1=y1-0.5cos(y1)-pi/2, r2=y2-0.5cos(y2)-pi/2, true solution (pi/2,pi/2). The closed model is solved by the Simulink algebraic-loop solver (y_sim); the expanded model computes the residual r(y) with real blocks; PCU runs end-to-end from x0=0 (same initial point as Simulink): structure identification (periodic trigger) -> zero-crossing candidates -> Newton -> F verification (real residual).
